Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 004–012 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. The early Route 22 rival battle is available after parcel delivery; League and Johto corridors remain blocked. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Oak gives five Poké Balls during the parcel scene. The first lab victory brings your starter exactly to level 6. Long dialogue now scrolls fully, Daisy describes Blue as a new trainer, and the Trainer House has its own message. Blue keeps his chosen lab starter on Route 22. Choosing Togepi gives him a saved random Psyduck/Eevee of opposite gender; his starter shares the player’s shiny and perfect-IV odds. All generated Pokémon use 1-in-4,096 base shiny odds; the Shiny Charm in your bedroom PC doubles that chance. Only existing Yellow/HGSS Legendary encounter species receive guaranteed perfect IVs. Route 2 and Viridian Forest await the next build.
